data: Iyer et al. 2023 (figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.23849127, CC BY 4.0), features from backend.audio_features
protocol: StratifiedKFold (5 folds, 20 repeats), age-balanced sample weights; refit on all
limitations: Trained on 78 phone recordings of a sustained /a/ (39 people with Parkinson's, 39 healthy) from one public dataset, with age balancing because healthy participants were much younger. Cross-validated only; no external or clinical validation. Screening research output, not a diagnosis.
